brief: A habit tracker as a garden — daily completion waters plants, streaks bloom, neglect wilts

dominant_strengths: Garden metaphor cleanly maps habit states to plant lifecycle, giving visceral feedback that ties directly to the brief
Sky-to-soil vertical gradient creates a literal stage for growth, reinforcing the 'plant in dirt' narrative spatially
Status microcopy with emoji (fire, scroll, water, warning) communicates streak state quickly and warmly
dominant_weaknesses: Plant cards are enormous brown rectangles with vast empty soil — wasted vertical real estate flattens the visual rhythm
Flowers feel like flat clipart stickers rather than crafted illustrations; no wilt, no varied growth heights to show stages
Legend floats awkwardly over sky with mismatched card styling, and 'Needs Attention' card (Healthy Eating) shows no visual wilt — metaphor breaks
fix_priorities: Differentiate plant heights/states visibly — sprout, bud, bloom, wilt — so the garden actually reads as a status dashboard
Tighten card proportions and reduce dead soil space; let plants occupy meaningful vertical position tied to streak length
Upgrade illustration craft (shading, leaf variety, subtle sway animation) to earn the metaphor's emotional payoff
Integrate legend into the scene or footer rather than a floating card that competes with the title
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral metaphor leads but behavioral feedback is weak (no clear wilt for missed days) and reflective payoff is shallow without history or growth visualization.
rationale.intent_fit: Concept matches the brief literally, but execution under-delivers because the plants don't visibly water, bloom, or wilt in differentiated states.
